title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Access application links (Help, EULA, PrivacyStatement, and ContextSensitiveHelpUrl) through ModuleInfo – New properties on ModuleInfo
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) extends ModuleInfo to expose app manifest metadata including Help, EULA, PrivacyStatement, and ContextSensitiveHelpUrl properties. These new properties enable developers to access application links and locale-aware help URLs at runtime.
key_points: ModuleInfo now exposes four new properties for accessing app manifest metadata at runtime
New properties include Help link, EULA link, PrivacyStatement link, and context-sensitive help URL with locale resolution
Runtime version 18.0 or later is required to use these ModuleInfo properties
ContextSensitiveHelpUrl automatically resolves the user's locale from the application's supported locales

quotes.text: Read help, EULA, privacy statement, and locale-aware context-sensitive help links from an app manifest at runtime through additional ModuleInfo properties.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core capability added in BC29 for accessing application links programmatically

quotes.text: These properties require runtime version 18.0 or later
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the minimum version requirement for developers using these new ModuleInfo properties
